en: A black-and-white historical image showing a grand 19th-century colonnade building along a narrow river or canal. The architecture features ornate ironwork, classical columns, a large arched entrance with sculptures on top, and a dome structure. In the background are forested hills with villas, and a church with onion domes, typical of Central European spa towns. People in period dress are walking in front of the colonnade.
